_comment: Default 'upgrade selected' scripts, one per supported manager, that call the root-owned
wrappers instead of the app's built-in apt-get/snap/pacman/flatpak argv (which sudoers never grants).
register_systems.js converges them by name on every provisioning run (created when missing,
updated when they differ, never deleted). test_skpatch_hosts_sudo_coverage.py checks there is one

steps.label: Upgrading selected APT packages
steps.command:
# Upgrade only the selected APT packages through the root-owned wrapper
# (skstacks optional/skpatch-hosts: sudoers grants the wrapper, never an apt-get wildcard).
# Sudoers-relevant command: /usr/local/sbin/skpatch-apt-only-upgrade <pkgs>
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
if [ "$(id -u)" = "0" ]; then /usr/local/sbin/skpatch-apt-only-upgrade {{quotedPackages}}; else sudo -S -p '' /usr/local/sbin/skpatch-apt-only-upgrade {{quotedPackages}}; fi 2>&1

steps.label: Refreshing selected Snap packages
steps.command:
# Refresh only the selected Snap packages through the root-owned wrapper.
# Sudoers-relevant command: /usr/local/sbin/skpatch-snap-refresh <names>
if [ "$(id -u)" = "0" ]; then /usr/local/sbin/skpatch-snap-refresh {{quotedPackages}}; else sudo -S -p '' /usr/local/sbin/skpatch-snap-refresh {{quotedPackages}}; fi 2>&1

scripts.name: Pacman upgrade selected (skpatch wrapper)
scripts.description: Selected-package pacman upgrade via /usr/local/sbin/skpatch-pacman-upgrade (installed packages only).

steps.label: Upgrading selected Pacman packages
steps.command:
# Upgrade only the selected Pacman packages through the root-owned wrapper

# Sudoers-relevant command: /usr/local/sbin/skpatch-pacman-upgrade <pkgs>
if [ "$(id -u)" = "0" ]; then /usr/local/sbin/skpatch-pacman-upgrade {{quotedPackages}}; else sudo -S -p '' /usr/local/sbin/skpatch-pacman-upgrade {{quotedPackages}}; fi 2>&1

steps.label: Updating selected Flatpak apps
steps.command:
# Update only the selected Flatpak apps through the root-owned wrapper.
# Sudoers-relevant command: /usr/local/sbin/skpatch-flatpak-update <ids>
if [ "$(id -u)" = "0" ]; then /usr/local/sbin/skpatch-flatpak-update {{quotedPackages}}; else sudo -S -p '' /usr/local/sbin/skpatch-flatpak-update {{quotedPackages}}; fi 2>&1
